title: symphyotrichum lateriflorum var. spatelliforme
intro: Symphyotrichum lateriflorum var. spatelliforme, commonly known as the narrowleaf ironweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of Symphyotrichum lateriflorum var. spatelliforme include its potential to reduce oxidative stress, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant activity.
